scope: Path-only diagnosis on three already examined saved repeat-1 n192 splits; no fresh confirmatory test data
fixed_rule: Positive predictive-gain candidates; among them prefer positive dependency gain/cost. Otherwise positive predictive gain/cost. Nonpositive predictive bridge if none. Prediction-only stop and deletion.
empty_subset: Training global mean; accepted if inner guard passes
comparisons: Saved original Joint guard and Prediction-only outputs; all use same splits, scaling, folds and costs
test_role: Recorded after the selection checkpoint; descriptive only, not independent evidence or a tuning signal
